claim_ceiling: TF-IDF 174k complete and production-ready (cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5: LangDom=0.477, JuristPref=0.735). Linear combinations (equal concat of center_projected_64 + cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5) pass both adversarial gates at 19-year scale (122k decisions) with JP=0.540, LangDom=0.778, partially breaking the two-mode tradeoff. However, JuristPref ceiling remains at ~0.54 for stable combinations (vs TF-IDF 0.735), cross-lingual transfer remains weak (zero_shot_nmi ~0.2), and citation independence is sacrificed (CiteIndep ~0.31 vs 0.505 for metric-learning baseline). Full 174k dense embeddings blocked by source data gap (51,948 decisions missing, parquet missing, bge_↔bger_ ID mapping missing). Two-mode tradeoff reproduced at all scales: no single representation dominates all metrics. Product must expose multiple map modes.
evidence_summary: Verified across 9 primary evidence files in producer workspace: (1) 15yr linear_hybrid05_concat (JP=0.473 FAIL, LangDom=0.809 PASS); (2) 19yr dense eval (center_projected_64: LangDom=0.860 FAIL, JP=0.369 FAIL); (3) 19yr linear combinations (linear_citation_concat PASS: LangDom=0.767, JP=0.545; linear_hybrid05_concat PASS: LangDom=0.778, JP=0.540); (4) 19yr TF-IDF baseline (LangDom=0.472 PASS, JP=0.724 PASS); (5) Section cross-lingual (Sachverhalt cp_64: cross_lang=0.282, gap=0.187; Erwaegungen cp_64: cross_lang=0.094, gap=0.452 — center projection improves both); (6) v8 holdout (4 zero-shot TF-IDF hybrids PASS on true holdout, leakage minimal); (7) Dense checkpoints (122,015/173,963 decisions, 19/26 years, 2019 data quality issue noted); (8) TF-IDF 174k formal suite (6/8 representations visible in latest.json, all PASS both gates, production default best); (9) v29 final report (synthesis consistent with evidence). Three evidence files referenced in state not found in producer workspace (citation_heritage, v17b, v18) — claims accepted based on report consistency but not independently re-verified. No leakage, gaming, post-hoc metrics, weak baselines, prettiness-as-quality, benchmark gaming, boilerplate confounding, or unsupported product claims detected. Negative results honestly reported.
